definitions.name: gaussianPDF
definitions.literal_definition: def gaussianPDF (μ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPDFReal μ v x)

definitions.name: gaussianPDFReal
definitions.literal_definition:
def gaussianPDFReal (μ : ℝ) (v : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (√(2 * π * v))⁻¹ * rexp (-(x - μ) ^ 2 / (2 * v))
